snippet.title: We Went to the Sabres’ First Playoff Game in 14 Years
snippet.description:
Buffalo Sabres playoff hockey is FINALLY back.

After a 14-year drought — the longest active streak in the NHL — the Sabres returned to the Stanley Cup Playoffs. And we had to be there.

We got to KeyBank Center for Game 2 of the Sabres vs. Bruins first-round series to experience what this moment means to the city of Buffalo firsthand. From the streets outside the arena to inside the building, the atmosphere was something else.

We talked to Sabres fans who've waited 14 years for this. We took in every moment as the energy inside kept building all night. This wasn't just a game. This was Buffalo finally getting playoff hockey back.

Is this the best atmosphere in the NHL right now?
